title: Your Phone Is Not Outplaying Physics
excerpt: DPReview shot the iPhone 18 Pro against the OM-1 with the same total light reaching each sensor. The results matched. The difference is processing, not the sensor.

title: Your Landscapes Look Flat Because They Have One Layer
excerpt: A landscape loses its depth when the foreground, middle ground, and background never connect. Photographer Kate Garibaldi shows how layering brings a distant view to life.

title: The Retro Camera Boom Is Not About Nostalgia
excerpt: Young photographers who never shot film are buying cameras with dials, levers, and grain. Digital Camera World argues the appeal is novelty, not nostalgia, and the lesson is about how the camera makes you shoot.
